channel.description: Recent content in Guides on Drasi Sentinel Docs

item.title: Start a watch
item.description:
Read the Agent Card at /.well-known/agent-card.json once. A skill tagged continuous-query is one watch. Its description says what is watched. Its examples, when present, are utterances that select it.

Send one message

Choose a new taskId and messageId. POST message/stream to the JSON-RPC URL on the card. The user text is one example from the chosen skill, or the skill description when it lists no examples. That text is the whole message.

item.title: Keep the stream open
item.description:
A watch can stay open for hours or days. The HTTP response is the delivery channel. Do not close it because it has been idle.

What an idle stream looks like

The host writes an SSE comment at least every 15 seconds:

: ping

A comment has no id line and is not an event. Do not treat it as a diff. Do not set a read timeout on this stream. A timeout will drop a healthy watch.

item.title: Ask for current results
item.description:
Current results are not a second watch. Send the request on the task a watch already opened.

Use a new messageId and this text as the only text part:

What are the current results for this task?

The output is an artifact update whose data type is current_query_results. It contains taskId, subscriptionId, queryId, queryDescription, and rows.

Do not send a query id, a source name, Cypher, or a filter. The host resolves the task’s subscription.

item.title: Set a lifetime
item.description:
Every watch has a lifetime. Put it in the opening message:

Tell me when an invoice is paid. Keep the watch for 7 days.

Accepted tokens are none, or a positive integer plus s, m, h, or d. 7d is seven days. none means the watch does not expire, unless the manifest caps it.

If you leave it out

The agent asks how long to keep the watch. Answer on the same task. Do not open a new task for the answer.

item.title: Author a query
item.description:
Query authoring is off unless the manifest sets service.query_authoring.enabled to true. That setting requires exactly one reaction. The host binds that reaction to the query the agent commits.

Describe the change

If no continuous-query skill matches, send the description as the whole user text on a new task. Do not send Cypher, a source name, a filter, or a destination.

Include the lifetime in that text. The building comfort and curbside demos are hosts that work this way.
